title: Barcelona · Montserrat and Priorat Long Sweep
slogan: A 346 km loop out of Montserrat mountain road
story: Sawtooth mountains, wine roads and a grown-up Catalan riding day. Out of Collbató and back again: 346 km, roughly 6 h 39 in the saddle. It goes by way of Cardona castle sight, Siurana cliff village and in Falset. Montserrat mountain road is the high point. It is a high-mountain day.

title: Barcelona · Collada de Toses Pyrenean Doorway
slogan: A 258 km loop out of Vic
story: A serious northbound day into Pyrenean bend country. 258 km round from Vic - plan on about 4 h 58 of riding. On the way it passes Ripoll mountain and La Molina overnight option. The climb of the day is Collada de Toses. It tops out at about 1,850 m. The passes are the reason to go.
